:::{#sol-identity-practice}

$\matr{A}$ is a $2 \times 3$ [matrix](#def-matrix),
so @thm-identity applies with $m = 2$ and $p = 3$.
Then

$$
\ba
\matr{I}_2\,\matr{A}\,\matr{I}_3
&= \matr{I}_2\,\matr{A}
&& \text{(@thm-identity with } p = 3\text{)}
\\
&= \matr{A}
&& \text{(@thm-identity with } m = 2\text{)}
\\
&= \sbmat{2 & -1 & 0 \\ 5 & 3 & 1}.
\ea
$$

:::
